no-restricted-syntax.message: Design tokens hold bare RGB triplets, so `border-[var(--color-x)]` is INVALID CSS and is silently dropped. Use the registered utilities instead (border-border, bg-surface-low, text-outline, ...). See tailwind.config.ts.
